Usage: simdbench [flags]

Quick comparison on 1,048,576 float32 elements; -list inspects without measuring.

Options:
  -addition
    	alias for -group addition
  -computation
    	alias for -group computation
  -function string
    	deprecated alias: add, compute, or all
  -group string
    	benchmark group: addition, computation, or all (default "all")
  -list
    	list implemented kernels and runtime capabilities without benchmarking

Examples:
  simdbench -list
  simdbench -group addition
  simdbench -group computation
